end.summary:
Practised drawing dot pictures for square and triangular numbers.
Used stairs and grids to show how sequences grow between terms.
Explained the shared corner when adding a row and column to a square.
Used a picture to explain why a triangular number is half of a rectangle.
Teach-back was not completed; the first square/triangular drawing task was not completed unaided.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised representing square and triangular numbers with dot pictures and explaining sequence growth. They correctly used the shared-corner idea and later corrected the mix-up between the total number of dots and the number added. At home, ask them to draw 3×3 to 4×4 and label the new row, new column, and shared corner before finding the total added.
